{{Short description|Russian mathematician (born 1961)}}
[[File:Taymanov Isk.jpg|thumb|Iskander Taimanov]]

'''Iskander Asanovich Taimanov''' (born 20 December 1961, ''Искандер Асанович Тайманов'') is a Russian [[mathematician]] whose research concerns [[geometry]], [[calculus of variations]], and [[soliton theory]]. He is the chair of the department of geometry and topology of [[Novosibirsk State University]]. 

He is a member of the [[Russian Academy of Sciences]].<ref>[http://www.ras.ru/win/db/show_per.asp?P=.id-53784.ln-en Russian Academy of Sciences]</ref>

He was a Ph.D. student of [[Sergey Petrovich Novikov]].<ref>{{MathGenealogy|id=62901}}</ref> 

Some topics of his work are [[Morse–Novikov theory]] and [[Willmore surface]]s.<ref>{{Cite journal|last=Bohle|first=Christoph|date=2010-09-01|title=Constrained Willmore tori in the 4-sphere|url=http://projecteuclid.org/euclid.jdg/1299766684|journal=[[Journal of Differential Geometry]]|language=EN|volume=86|issue=1|pages=71–132|issn=0022-040X|arxiv=0803.0633}}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal|last=Bohle|first=Christoph|last2=Peters|first2=G. Paul|date=2011-01-01|title=Soliton spheres|url=http://www.ams.org/tran/2011-363-10/S0002-9947-2011-05323-7/|journal=[[Transactions of the American Mathematical Society]]|volume=363|issue=10|pages=5419–5463|doi=10.1090/S0002-9947-2011-05323-7|issn=0002-9947|doi-access=free|arxiv=0905.2162}}</ref><ref>{{Cite book|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=htkejhavo8AC&pg=PA131|title=Contact and Symplectic Geometry|last=Thomas|first=Charles Benedict|date=1996-09-28|publisher=[[Cambridge University Press]]|isbn=9780521570862|page=131|language=en}}</ref>

He is the author of the textbook ''Lectures on Differential Geometry''.<ref>{{cite web|author=Locascio, Andrew|date=February 17, 2009|title=Review of ''Lectures on Differential Geometry''|website=MAA Reviews, Mathematical Association of America|url=https://www.maa.org/press/maa-reviews/lectures-on-differential-geometry}}</ref>
